about_the_game:
Abrez is a thrilling arcade game that tests your precision and speed. The principle is simple: shoot at colorful cans moving along a conveyor belt. Some cans increase your score, while others decrease it. By shooting at coins, you can fill your basket to buy special balls: single, triple, or explosive, capable of hitting multiple targets at once.

Be careful: if too many pyramids or groups of cans reach the end of the conveyor without being hit, you immediately lose the current level! Each level lasts 3 minutes, requiring quick thinking, strategy, and sharp aim to achieve the highest scores.

Players can buy and sell their balls to better adapt to each situation and optimize their performance. For added convenience, pressing the space bar on the keyboard brings up an image displaying all the main keyboard shortcuts and compatible controller buttons to help you control your game.

Finally, a leaderboard is automatically updated, showing each player's nickname, avatar, and best score. Challenge your friends, climb to the top of the rankings, and become the master of Abrez!
